what: The Supervisor of Elections’ Gazette notices for 1954, 1957, 1961 and 1962 give each winner’s votes. 35 winners match ElectionPassport and 2 were corrected: 1954 Carriacou (Paterson 1,295, not 1,296) and 1962 St. Andrew South (Bhola 1,609, not 1,610). The 1962 Carriacou seat, missing from ElectionPassport, was added: Herbert Blaize, returned unopposed. Two Gazette digits are unclear: 1954 St. George’s Town (983 or 988) and 1957 St. David (985 or 983). The notices don’t give losing candidates’ votes, so those remain secondary (✱).
action: Find each election’s full returns (Returning Officers’ statements or the Legislative Council papers) to verify losing candidates and settle the two unclear digits.
sources: Government Gazette (Extraordinary) No. 54/1954, No. 53/1957, No. 18/1961, Nos. 56 and 63/1962
